title: Three Sundays and One Short Note
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：impression　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 impression 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the interviewer ① left the impression that no candidate in the room would have described, and he said the leaving was the whole of the Sunday. The ② impression, meaning the feeling itself and not the note, ran three Sundays and stayed undescribed in the book; a impression, he said, is the only thing in a room that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ impression in that room had the same short note beside it, and the ④ impression at the far desk, meaning the mark they kept for the children to leave and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A impression, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the interviewer said the describing is the part that fills three Sundays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the impression was the whole of the matter, meaning the sense and not the feeling. The ⑥ impression, meaning the sense and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; impression, he said, is either something you leave or the only word that means both a feeling and a sense. He said the sense is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ impression had become a line in a form, and the form had become an argument about the short note. The ⑧ impression of the whole thing, the interviewer wrote in March, was one room and three Sundays of describing; impression, he said, is either the mark at the far desk or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ impression I remember is the feeling described in the form, which closed in 1998 and is still described as the quietest in the room. A ⑩ impression, my mother said in 2000, is the only feeling that improves by being described; every impression, she said, is a sense that has agreed to look like a feeling. She said the sense was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 印象；感想（指会客室里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 印象；感想（指那份感觉本身，与便条相对）
C. 固定搭配：leave the impression 留下印象
D. n. 印象；感想（指留给孩子们留下的那一处那一份）
E. n. 印象之事（抽象总称，指一处会客室的印象之事）
F. n. 印象；感想（指表格里写到、被记下的的那一份）
G. n. 感觉、意味（指一件事里人人都记却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 意味（抽象总称，指人人都记却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: left the impression that no candidate in the room would have described
The impression, meaning the feeling itself and not the note
the impression at the far desk
the impression was the whole of the matter
the impression had become a line in a form
The impression of the whole thing
A impression, my mother said in 2000

answers.why: leave the impression 意为“留下印象”，1991 年那位面试官把会客室里没有一位应试者肯描述的一种印象做了一遍。
impression 意为“印象；感想”，指那份感觉本身而不是便条，它经过了三个星期天而在簿子上没有被描述。
impression 意为“印象；感想”，指会客室里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一张薄薄的便条。
impression 意为“印象；感想”，指最远那张书桌留给孩子们留下的那一处那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
impression 意为“感觉、意味”，指一件事里人人都记却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种感觉就是那件事的全部。
impression 意为“意味”，指人人都记却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份感觉，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
impression 意为“印象；感想”，指表格里写到、被记下的的那一份，到 1996 年这一份成了表格里的一行。
impression 意为“印象之事”，面试官三月写道，整件事的印象之事是一处会客室和三个星期天的描述。
impression 意为“印象；感想”，我记得的是表格里描述过的那一份，1998 年定下了，至今仍被说成会客室里最安静的一份。
impression 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，印象是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的感觉。
